description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must assign two available pallet positions on today's routine airlift among three approved sustainment cargoes, designate the aircraft's single powered position, and record the coordination actions needed before loading.

shared_context.S1: Today's scheduled aircraft has two available pallet positions, and only one of those positions provides continuous electrical power during flight.
shared_context.S2: Three approved cargoes are staged for consideration: medical vaccine cases, an avionics diagnostic module, and water-purification cartridges.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez signs the final pallet allocation and loading instructions.
shared_context.S4: The airfield loadmaster's standard pre-load procedure is a brief weekly logistics huddle: medical logistics and maintenance control each state their current cargo-handling or movement constraints, and Maj. Alvarez signs the allocation during that same huddle after both sections have reported.

PF1.text: The staged vaccine cases must remain in the aircraft's powered pallet position for the entire flight; Lt. Morgan confirmed this requirement with the clinic cold-chain custodian this morning, but the updated handling note has not yet been added to the lift manifest.

PF2.text: The avionics diagnostic module is a loaned higher-headquarters asset, and the loan record directs that it return on the next available aircraft; SFC Patel received the signed loan-record update from maintenance control this morning, but it has not yet been posted to the battalion cargo board.

acceptance_conditions: The medical vaccine cases must occupy one of the two pallet positions and a cold-chain confirmation must be recorded.
The avionics diagnostic module must occupy one of the two pallet positions and a higher-headquarters loan-return coordination action must be recorded.
The medical vaccine cases must be assigned to the powered position.
The water-purification cartridges must be identified as the deferred cargo.
The plan must include a manifest update.
The medical cold-chain requirement must be cited in the justification.
The higher-headquarters loan-return directive must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed and (decisions['cargo_slot_1'] == 'medical vaccine cases' or decisions['cargo_slot_2'] == 'medical vaccine cases') and any(c['type'] == 'cold_chain_confirmation' and c['target'] == 'medical vaccine cases' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in revealed and (decisions['cargo_slot_1'] == 'avionics diagnostic module' or decisions['cargo_slot_2'] == 'avionics diagnostic module') and any(c['type'] == 'loan_return_coordination' and c['target'] == 'higher headquarters' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed and decisions['powered_position_assignment'] == 'medical vaccine cases'
content_checks.C4: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in revealed and decisions['deferred_cargo'] == 'water-purification cartridges'
content_checks.C5: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed and any(c['type'] == 'manifest_update' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The vaccine requirement changes the powered-position assignment to exactly medical vaccine cases and requires a cold-chain confirmation and manifest update documenting that handling requirement.

The loan directive changes the selected second cargo to exactly avionics diagnostic module, makes water-purification cartridges the deferred cargo, and requires coordination of its return to higher headquarters.
